lore_anchors.definition: The nine disparate Chaosworlds conquered by the Nine Chaos Lord; Celestial Immortals and Empyrean Gods from these realms serve under him.
The crystallized essence of a dead Chaosworld, used as a catalyst for supreme avatar techniques like the Thousand Bodies Sacred Scripture.
A legendary Chaos Outsider technique for crafting powerful Dao talismans, considered the most valuable of the seven secret arts.
The seventh stage of Ki Refining, achieved after successfully transcending the Heavenly Tribulation, granting a virtually limitless lifespan.
The seventh stage of Fiendgod Body Refining, the equivalent of a Celestial Immortal, characterized by an indestructible divine body.
Any life form from a Chaosverse other than the native Three Realms; their techniques and treasures often require exotic substances unavailable in the Three Realms.

cultural_notes_faq.a: It is the crystallized essence of an entire Chaosworld that has aged, died, and collapsed; it is so rare that it doesn't exist in the isolated Three Realms.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did Patriarch Subhuti kill Shaoyan Chou so easily?
cultural_notes_faq.a: As a Daofather, Subhuti's power is on a completely different plane; he can influence the truesouls of weak cultivators like Celestial Immortals across the Three Realms with a thought.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the author's note at the end for?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It's a standard practice in Chinese web novels where the author ("Tomato") communicates directly with fans about updates and shares community news like new illustrations.
